verificationRecords.focus: story-026 depositFor settlement fix on V2 (audit-21 M-03 / b3243f42 at source)
verificationRecords.detail: Pre-credit settlement of an existing position now pays `_safePayTo(user, pending)` (line 782) instead of V1's `_safePay(pending)` == `_safePayTo(msg.sender=MIGRATOR, ...)`. Routes the staker's earned phUSD to the staker. Confirmed not weaponizable: (a) onlyMigrator (774) + Active gate (776) — no unprivileged/forced call; (b) no re-injection haircut vs stable-staker ss12m1 — the ERC1155 deposit (786) brings no reward tokens, committedDebt is reduced by the settled pending, budget re-derived as V-committedDebt in tail _recomputeSchedule (793); rate = budget/window is totalStaked-independent so no dilution of other stakers' owed debt; (c) no double-pay across a migrator round-trip — batchMigrate/userMigrate zero the position (amount=0/rewardDebt=0), so a subsequent depositFor takes the info.amount==0 branch and SKIPS the settle; the settle only fires on a genuinely-earned delta and rewardDebt is re-pinned to full accRewardPerShare (789); (d) reentrancy-safe — nonReentrant, phUSD is trusted non-callback ERC20, and the only inbound ERC1155 transfer (786) has receiver=this (ERC1155Holder, benign selector return).

verificationRecords.focus: M-03 (b3243f42) migrator-side capture-and-forward guard MUST NOT be collapsed
verificationRecords.verdict: GUARD STILL LOAD-BEARING — DO NOT PROPOSE CLOSING
verificationRecords.detail: V2 fixes the misroute at source, but the three live mainnet depletion stakers (EYE/SCX/FLX) run V1, whose depositFor still pays the migrator (line 778, retained by design + NatSpec warning). Any orchestrator driving a V1 instance still relies on the migrator-side capture-and-forward (_depositForAndForward). The V2 source fix is ADDITIVE, not a replacement for the migrator guard; ledger entry b3243f42 stays open/relied-upon for V1. Recorded per run brief to prevent a downstream agent collapsing it.

verificationRecords.focus: story-027 stake() Active gate on V2 + MigrateReady (audit-20 M-05 / bdf84579)
verificationRecords.verdict: WEDGE CLOSED FOR NEW DEPLOYMENTS, NO LEGITIMATE FLOW WEDGED
verificationRecords.detail: `require(poolState == PoolState.Active)` added to stake() ONLY (name-normalized diff confirms this is the sole stake-side delta). A permissionless stake can no longer push totalStaked>0 during Migrating and wedge finalizeAndReset (require totalStaked==0). All drain paths stay OPEN while Migrating: unstake (577, ungated), claim (594, ungated), emergencyWithdraw (639, ungated+works-paused), userMigrate (722, requires Migrating), batchMigrate (692, requires Migrating). depositFor is also Active-gated (776) — correct: it seeds the healthy/Active target, never the frozen pool; the in-place round-trip re-enters Active via finalizeAndReset before any depositFor. After finalizeAndReset the pool is Active and stake() resumes. Same gate verified present in NFTStakerPriceScaledMigrateReady per story-027.

verificationRecords.focus: DepletionV2 drift vs Depletion V1 beyond the two intended deltas
verificationRecords.detail: Name-normalized full-file diff (sed DepletionV2->Depletion) yields ONLY two code-line differences: stake() Active gate (557) and depositFor _safePayTo (782); every other hunk is NatSpec. Security-relevant slices confirmed byte-identical to V1: _updatePool (460-484, rate NOT recomputed in accrual — phlimbo rate-drift class avoided), _recomputeSchedule (524-545, budget=V-committedDebt clamp, floor rate, no ceiling), _syncBudget (435-447, _updatePool before pull(), inflow via balance-diff), emergencyWithdraw (639-654, CEI + forfeit-to-budget), batchMigrate/_exitPosition (692-753, CEI zero-before-transfer), _safePayTo (620-632, solvency decrement + dust-escape). Solvency invariant balance==rewardBudget+committedDebt preserved.

Classic single-fn: nonReentrant + CEI + phUSD non-callback. Cross-function: OZ ReentrancyGuard lock is contract-wide, blocks sibling re-entry across stake/unstake/claim/emergencyWithdraw/depositFor/batchMigrate/userMigrate/initiateMigration. Cross-contract: the only non-guarded functions are onlyOwner (finalizeAndReset, setters, rescueERC20, topUp, pullAndRefresh) — an attacker in an onERC1155Received callback cannot reach them. Read-only reentrancy: every outbound ERC1155 transfer that fires onERC1155Received on an attacker recipient (unstake 590, emergencyWithdraw 652, userMigrate 726, batchMigrate 710) executes AFTER all state settlement (CEI), so views (pendingReward/totalDebt/runwaySeconds/totalBudget) read consistent state during the callback window. ERC1155 inbound hooks (stake 570, depositFor 786) have receiver=this (ERC1155Holder). ERC777/ERC721: N/A. dispatcherHook.pull() (441) is a semi-trusted head-of-fn call under nonReentrant; a broken hook bricks stake/unstake/claim but emergencyWithdraw escape hatch is hook-free (by design, owner-trusted).

verificationRecords.focus: Slither/Aderyn Tier-1 leads re-examined at interaction level
verificationRecords.detail: batchMigrate:702 `uint256 totalAmount;` — uninitialized-local defaults to 0, accumulator pattern, benign (false positive). runwaySeconds:875 strict-equality `rewardRate==0` — div-by-zero guard, benign. state-change-after-external-call 570/786 — both are inbound stakedToken.safeTransferFrom(->this) with receiver=this, followed by user.amount/totalStaked/rewardDebt updates, under nonReentrant; no attacker callback (ERC1155Holder), standard masterchef pattern. All flagged pull-on-interaction reentrancy (_syncBudget/stake/unstake/claim/depositFor) covered by contract-wide guard + CEI above.
